d: Bihar ki rajniti men lalu prasad yadav ki beti rohini aachary dvara mukhyamantri nitish kumar ke aavas par chhath mahaparv ke dauran kharna ka prasad khane jane ki bat kahe jane ke bad janta dal yunaited (JDU) ki or se aadhikarik pratikriya samne aaee hai. JDU ke rashtriy pravakta abhishek jha ne is pure ghatnakram, mahagathbandhan ke davon aur haliya MLC chunav ke parinamon ko lekar parti ka paksh spasht kiya hai.
